title: A Serpentine Belt Can Be Worn Without Looking Cracked
topic: Modern EPDM serpentine belts can wear through rib material loss without dramatic cracking
mechanicTruth: Modern EPDM serpentine belts resist visible cracking, so crack-counting alone can miss wear; rib material loss and profile change, along with tensioner and pulley condition, are more useful inspection clues.

voiceoverScript: Modern EPDM serpentine belts can resist visible cracking even as they wear. Rib material loss and profile change can tell more than crack-counting alone. The tensioner and pulleys matter too, because the belt works as a system.
selectedCaption: No cracks does not automatically equal no wear on a modern EPDM serpentine belt. Rib profile, material loss, tensioner, and pulleys all belong in the inspection.
avoidedForRepetition: Distinct from cold-start belt squeal: this is how modern EPDM wear can hide without dramatic cracks.
